verdict.rationale: Code is portable in an open format: repositories work with any Git client over HTTPS/SSH, and branches can be mirrored to another Git server. Issues, pull requests and reviews can be kept in sync with GitHub in both directions, but the docs only describe this for repos brought in from GitHub, so it is not a general exit path. The REST API's JSON output is only a building block, not an export feature in itself. missing for 10: a documented full-account/organization data export (issues, PRs, reviews, comments, settings) in open formats for native GitCafe repos, any account-deletion/offboarding guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of leaving with complete data.
